housing: Peoria's rentals are mostly single-family houses in planned communities with homeowners associations, plus newer apartment complexes along the main roads.

localRules.text: Every rental home in Maricopa County must be registered with the County Assessor, and the city where it sits enforces this.

climate: Run the air conditioning during the inspection and photograph the outdoor unit and roof; summer heat makes a broken AC an urgent repair, and monsoon dust storms can damage screens and pools.
fact: Many Peoria rentals are in HOA communities, so tenants usually have to follow the association's rules on parking, trash cans and yards.
